sourceAudioBoundaryCheck.limitation: Two current requests only; no claim about earlier resolved URLs or native seek behavior. Probe source remains parked in scratch under this open issue.

observerProvenance.note: Collector source is identical across measured observer runs. Early runs precede compiler-TEMP wrapping, early path validation and fixture-mode parameters; actual YouTube mode is disconnect, final fixture is relay. Observer writes numeric state only, never foreground titles/pixels/identifiers. Awake requests are temporary and restored in finally; no focus, input, lock or persistent power policy changes.

sourceReview.finding: Statistics getter copies the stored input statistics.
Input-loop statistics refresh is scheduled after demux, with a 250000-microsecond next-update target. This is not a guaranteed independent wall-clock refresh.
VLCJ creates a Java statistics snapshot from the native structure. Source behavior motivates a publication/cadence hypothesis, not proof of the observed root cause.
buffers_played increments after aout_OutputPlay. Its value is not an independent audio-device consumption timestamp; buffered output or publication timing can make a zero delta ambiguous.
